report.answer: The program sampled in the Phase-0 CI baseline (28 of 60 snapshot-era test-python steps, classified convenience). Independent reviewer bound at 95% is K=4 defective steps (rate=0.06666666666666667) assuming 0 defects in the executed 28. That does not license a confidence claim about the unexecuted remainder. Live AUD-0041 counts 63 steps in today's test-python job (frame drift vs snapshot 60). Phase 11's stratified claim sample was not drawn: CLAIM-REGISTRY.json has 12 claims and 0 severity labels; CNF sampling frames are absent, so the bound is NOT-COMPUTABLE. AUD-0086's 'representative' shell round-trip is constructed controls (convenience), not a seeded draw. A convenience sample labelled stratified is reclassified. A sample with unknown N returns NOT-COMPUTABLE, never the planted 0.95. SUCCESS:BLD-0062

entries.name: Phase 0 baseline: 28 of 60 CI-declared test steps executed
entries.notes: BASELINE-SNAPSHOT.json is present. test_baseline.suites_attempted=28 of a quality.yml test-python job the snapshot described as 60 steps; 32 were NOT-CHECKED. Live AUD-0041 YAML inventory counts 63 steps in today's test-python job. The 28-of-60 frame is the snapshot-era convenience sample (the suites that happened to run), not a seeded stratified draw. Bound uses that recorded frame (N=60,n=28, zero observed defects at step grain). Live 63 is frame drift, not a redraw of the historical sample.

snapshot_test_baseline.headline: 5326 tests pass. ZERO of the 8 counted failures survive triage as a real regression on main @ 53c37c6c: 3 are a Windows CRLF artifact, 4 were a sibling's transient red phase, 1 is a POSIX-only test. The residual is one order/load-dependent flake plus a genuine Windows-portability defect in the command-center REACH-6 gate.
snapshot_test_baseline.not_checked_reason: quality.yml's test-python job declares 60 steps. 28 were run here. The other 32 are non-pytest gates (validate.py/render.py/lint), isolated-venv py3.12 trees (wearables, abbyy-finereader-ocr-mcp, omniaudit-mcp), or require editable installs. Those are NOT-CHECKED, not passing.

entries.name: AUD-0086 planned representative sample through each target shell
entries.notes: Catalog evidence_requirement names a representative round-trip sample through each target shell. Those controls are not a seeded draw from the census population, so the representative label is convenience and the round-trip bound is NOT-COMPUTABLE (population of 'commands that would be round-tripped' was never enumerated as a sampling frame).
